display.purpose: The single page thesis line. One per surface.

body.purpose: Argument prose, held to a 68ch measure.

body-dense.purpose: List content and supporting prose that must pack without dropping below reading size.

label.purpose: Field names in rows; section headings at 0.1em tracking, always real heading elements.

machine.purpose: Routes, counts, dispositions, shell commands. Anything an agent reads verbatim.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Probe rows arrive in sequence, 55ms apart, from opacity 0.35 and 7px below rest. Gated on prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The only easing curve in the build: fast out, long soft landing.

components.name: Inline Link
components.description: A printed reference. Amber hairline underline that thickens on hover; nothing moves.
components.html: the plain text index, addressed to agents
components.css: .ds-link { font-family: var(--font-prose, Georgia), serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink, #16150f); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--sap, #91500f); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--sap, #91500f); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-link:visited { color: var(--ink-2, #57544a); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sap, #91500f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Masthead navigation. Muted at rest, amber and underlined on hover.
components.html: probesresultsthe loop/arena
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.875rem; } .ds-navlink { font-family: var(--font-prose, Georgia), serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink-2, #57544a); text-decoration: none; } .ds-navlink:hover { color: var(--sap, #91500f); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--sap, #91500f); text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-navlink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sap, #91500f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-navlink-route { font-family: var(--font-machine, ui-monospace), monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--sap, #91500f); }

components.name: Probe Row
components.description: The signature index entry: rank, route, disposition, then measures against refuses.
components.html:
• 1/arena/alarmrestraint
    measures
    whether the model stops at the question asked.
    refuses
    the quality of any explanation it writes.
components.css: .ds-row { list-style: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9d6c9); padding: 0.875rem 0; font-family: var(--font-prose, Georgia), serif; color: var(--ink, #16150f); } .ds-row-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.625rem; } .ds-rank, .ds-route, .ds-disp { font-family: var(--font-machine, ui-monospace), monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-rank { width: 1rem; flex: none; text-align: right; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2, #57544a); } .ds-route { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #16150f); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--sap, #91500f); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-route:hover { color: var(--sap, #91500f); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-route:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sap, #91500f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-disp { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--frond, #2f4f3a); } .ds-dl { margin: 0.375rem 0 0 1.625rem; display: grid; gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-dl { grid-template-columns: 4.75rem 1fr; } } .ds-dt { font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--ink-2, #57544a); padding-top: 3px; } .ds-dd { margin: 0; max-width: 68ch; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-dd-muted { color: var(--ink-2, #57544a); }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: A real h2 with an id, set as a tracked-open label. Never a decorative kicker above a headline.
components.css: .ds-heading { font-family: var(--font-prose, Georgia), serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--ink-2, #57544a); margin: 0 0 0.75rem; }

components.name: Command Block
components.description: The primary action: a printed curl sequence, rule-bounded, scrollable, no chrome.
components.css: .ds-cmd { font-family: var(--font-machine, ui-monospace), monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--ink, #16150f); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9d6c9); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9d6c9); padding: 1rem 0; margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-cmd { font-size: 12.5px; } }

components.name: Empty Slot
components.description: A deliberate empty state for data that does not exist yet. Replaced only by real measurements.
components.css: .ds-empty { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 9rem; padding: 0 1rem; overflow: hidden; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9d6c9); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9d6c9); } .ds-soon { font-family: var(--font-machine, ui-monospace), monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 6vw, 3.25rem); letter-spacing: 0.22em; color: var(--ink-3, #78756a); transform: rotate(-11deg); user-select: none; margin: 0; }

components.name: Masthead Mark
components.description: The frond: stroked SVG, one leaflet pair per probe, count derived at render time.
components.css: .ds-mast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink, #16150f); } .ds-frond { width: 3.6rem; color: var(--frond, #2f4f3a); } .ds-frond path { stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.15; stroke-linecap: round; fill: none; } .ds-frond .ds-rachis { stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-wordmark { font-family: var(--font-prose, Georgia), serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-mast:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sap, #91500f); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
arenga has no theme and no metaphor. It is the shape that lesswrong, hacker news and reddit share once their differences are stripped off: an item list and an attention signal, set in text dense enough that a reader can judge the argument in fifteen seconds without being sold anything. The palette borrows its two non-neutral values from the sugar palm the project is named for, amber sap and frond green, but they are working colors with jobs, not a costume. Nothing on this surface exists to set a mood.

Depth is entirely absent. There are no cards, no shadows, no gradients, no icon tiles, no rounded corners anywhere. Structure comes from hairline rules, a single tonal panel value, and the difference between two typefaces. The one authored motion moment, probe rows settling in sequence, starts from a state that is already legible if it never runs.

The only ornament is the type split: Literata carries argument, Geist Mono carries machine text. That split is load bearing, not decorative, and it is the first thing a new surface has to get right. Site copy is all lowercase and free of em dashes, inherited as a brand requirement, and the register is flat: the page never praises, reassures, or urges.
keyCharacteristics: Flat paper, zero elevation, zero radius
Hairline rules as the only container
One serif, one mono, and nothing else
Two accents with exactly one job each
Single measured column (45rem shell, 68ch text measure)
Tabular numerals on every rendered figure

rules.name: The Two Signal Rule
rules.body: The palette carries exactly two non-neutral values and each owns one meaning: amber means acting, green means classifying. A new surface that needs a third meaning uses an ink step, not a new hue.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Text lives at one of three weights of the same warm black. Anything quieter than faded ink is not quiet, it is missing.

rules.name: The Browser Surface Rule
rules.body: Theming does not stop at the page: scrollbar, selection, and caret all carry project colors. A new surface sets them too.

rules.name: The Split Rule
rules.body: Serif carries argument. Mono carries machine text: routes, counts, dispositions, shell commands, anything an agent would read verbatim. Nothing else. Mono is never worn as a costume to make prose look technical, and serif is never used to print a command.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every figure rendered in mono uses tabular numerals so columns of counts and ranks align without a table.

rules.name: The Lowercase Copy Rule
rules.body: Nav, labels, headings and body copy are lowercase; proper nouns keep their case. No em dashes anywhere. This is a brand requirement, not a stylistic preference, and it is checked mechanically.

rules.name: The Rule Is The Container Rule
rules.body: Grouping is expressed by a 1px horizontal rule and vertical spacing. Nothing on this surface gets a box, a background tint, or a padded card to say "these belong together."

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are paper. If a new element seems to need a shadow to read, it needs a rule, a space step, or a different ink weight instead.

rules.name: The Single Edge Rule
rules.body: Borders mark a boundary between things, so they appear on one or two edges. A four-sided border draws a box, and this system has no boxes.

rules.name: The Derived Number Rule
rules.body: Every number rendered on a surface, including the leaflet count in the mark, is computed from lib/probes/ at render time. No figure is typed into a component, and no figure that is not measured appears at all.

rules.name: The Legible-From-Rest Rule
rules.body: Animation may only move an element from a state that is already readable. If turning the animation off changes what the page says, the animation is doing work it should not be doing.

dos: Do keep serif on argument and mono on machine text, and treat that split as the surface's only ornament.
Do express grouping with a 1px hairline and vertical space; use the heavier rule for the two structural edges.
Do hold prose to a 68ch measure inside the 45rem shell.
Do give amber every interactive affordance and green nothing but classification.
Do set tabular numerals on any rendered figure.
Do derive every number on the page from lib/probes/ at render time.
Do theme the browser surface (selection, caret, scrollbar, focus ring) alongside the page.
Do wrap any motion in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and start it from a legible state.
Do write copy lowercase, flat in register, with no em dashes.
donts: Don't add a shadow, gradient, card, icon tile, or corner radius. The system is flat, square, and rule-bound.
Don't put a four-sided border around a region; single edges only.
Don't set mono on prose to make it look technical, or set serif on a command.
Don't introduce a third hue. A new meaning takes an ink step.
Don't print a count, rank, or result that is not derived from real data; there are no users, no adoption numbers, and no published results to show.
Don't fill the results slot with decoration while it waits for real measurements.
Don't use a glyph-font or packaged icon set; the one mark on this surface is drawn as stroked SVG.
